docs.title: CLI reference
docs.text:
Every mapi command with its --help, generated from the installed CLI by scripts/gen_docs_reference.py. The command-line guide shows them in use. Global options (--url, --token, --profile, --json) go before the command: mapi --json runs ls.

Command What it does mapi new Scaffold a ModelSpec YAML from a template (geo-mmm, forecast, tabular, glm). mapi check Statically validate a spec (exit status 1 when it has errors). mapi fit Fit a spec locally (in-process) or on the API (--remote). mapi score Score a fitted bundle locally, or a model version on the API (--remote). mapi catalog Show the catalog of the locally installed plugins (or the API's with --remote). mapi login Sign in to the API (browser OIDC, device code, or an API token). mapi logout Forget the stored sign-in and API token of the profile. mapi whoami Who you are, how you are signed in, and the projects you can use. mapi use Select the project commands act in (sent as X-Mapi-Project), or show it. mapi usage Cost and quota use of the selected project (or --tenant) for a UTC day or month. mapi signup Create a workspace: sends a verification e-mail (valid 24 hours). mapi verify-email Redeem a verification token: creates your workspace and its default project. mapi serve Start the local development stack (API, embedded Postgres, GCS shim). mapi runs Inspect and control runs on the API. mapi runs ls List runs, newest first. mapi runs get Show one run (state, failure, cost, problem). mapi runs logs Print captured log lines (untrusted text, control characters stripped). mapi runs watch Follow a run's live events until it ends (--json: one JSON event per line). mapi runs cancel Request cancellation (idempotent). mapi runs retry Start a new run from a failed one (e.g. one resource class up). mapi datasets Datasets on the API. mapi datasets ls List datasets. mapi datasets upload Upload a file as a new dataset version (signed PUT + sandboxed ingest run). mapi plugin Plugin authoring: scaffold and test model plugins. mapi plugin init Scaffold a plugin package (model, entry point and contract-kit tests). mapi plugin test Run the plugin's tests (contract kit) with this interpreter; extra args go to pytest. mapi spec Spec document tools. mapi spec upgrade Upgrade a document through the registered converters (N-1 → N). mapi config Client configuration (~/.config/mapi/config.toml). mapi config show Resolved settings and where each came from (secrets are never shown). mapi config path Print the config file location. mapi config set Set a key of the profile (--profile, MAPI_PROFILE, else the default profile). mapi config unset Remove a key from the profile (token too: prefer mapi logout). mapi tokens API tokens of the selected project (secrets are shown once, at creation). mapi tokens ls List tokens (yours, or everyone's with --all). mapi tokens get Show one token (never its secret). mapi tokens create Mint a token in the selected project. Its secret is shown once. mapi tokens revoke Revoke a token: programs using it stop working at once. mapi admin Platform operator commands: tenants, quotas, kill switches, executors, audit. mapi admin audit The platform audit log, newest first (times in UTC). mapi admin tenants All tenants (create, change tier/status/residency). mapi admin tenants ls List all tenants. mapi admin tenants get Show one tenant. mapi admin tenants create Create a tenant. mapi admin tenants update Change a tenant's name, trust tier, status or data residency. mapi admin quotas Quota policies per token, tenant or the platform. mapi admin quotas ls List quota policies. mapi admin quotas set Create or REPLACE the policy of (scope, subject): limits left out are removed. mapi admin quotas rm Remove a policy (the tier default applies again). mapi admin kill-switches Platform-wide emergency controls (audited). mapi admin kill-switches get Show the kill switches. mapi admin kill-switches set Flip kill switches (confirmation shows the change; the server audits it). mapi admin executors Executor health, capacity and conformance. mapi admin executors ls Executor health, load and conformance. mapi admin executors get One executor. mapi admin executors disable Disable an executor: no new run is placed on it (incident containment). mapi admin executors enable Enable an executor again. mapi endpoints Endpoints: stable aliases for promoted model versions (promote, score, snippets). mapi endpoints ls List the project's endpoints. mapi endpoints get Show an endpoint, the version it serves and its promotion gate. mapi endpoints history Promotions and rollbacks, newest first. mapi endpoints promote Point an alias at a model version, through the scorecard promotion gate. mapi endpoints rollback Point the alias back at an earlier revision's version. mapi endpoints schema What to send: the input schema frozen at promotion and an example payload. mapi endpoints score Score the endpoint's current version and wait for the result. mapi endpoints snippets Ready-to-run code that scores the endpoint (reads the token from MAPI_TOKEN). mapi webhooks Webhooks of the selected project (secrets are shown once, at creation). mapi webhooks ls List webhooks (never their secrets). mapi webhooks get Show one webhook (never its secret). mapi webhooks create Add a webhook. Its signing secret is printed once. mapi webhooks update Change a webhook: switch it back on after it was paused or disabled automatically, or change its events, URL or description. The secret is unchanged. mapi webhooks rotate New signing secret (printed once); the current one keeps signing for 24 hours. mapi webhooks deliveries The delivery log, newest first. mapi webhooks replay Send a delivery's event again (a new delivery). mapi webhooks rm Delete a webhook and its delivery log. mapi plots Render plots to files and share them as embed links. mapi plots render Render one plot to a PNG, SVG or PDF file. mapi plots embed Create a read-only embed link for a saved plot. Its URL is printed once. mapi plots embeds List a saved plot's embed links (redacted). mapi plots revoke Revoke an embed link: dashboards showing it stop at once. mapi guided Guided mode: templates, column detection and drafts (stores nothing). mapi guided templates List the guided templates, or one template's questions. mapi guided detect Suggest which column answers each question of a template. mapi guided draft Answers -> the ingest mapping and the ModelSpec YAML (nothing is stored). mapi priors Business priors: translate beliefs into model priors. mapi priors preview Translate beliefs into priors in the sandbox and preview them. mapi tenant Your workspace (tenant): verification status, GDPR export and deletion. mapi tenant status Verification (e-mail, identity, code upload) and any deletion of the tenant. mapi tenant export GDPR export: everything the tenant stored, as one zip archive. mapi tenant delete Schedule deletion of the whole tenant (cancellable during the grace period).

docs.title: Error codes
docs.text: Every error is a MapiError with one of these stable codes. Over HTTP it becomes an RFC 7807 problem document (application/problem+json) whose type ends in the code. Anything your data or a plugin said is returned separately, as untrusted_text.

docs.title: Spec and static validation
docs.text: Code HTTP Meaning Retryable SCHEMA_INVALID 422 The document does not match its schema – SPEC_PARSE_ERROR 400 The document could not be parsed – PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE 413 The document exceeds a size limit – UNSUPPORTED_API_VERSION 422 Unsupported apiVersion – REF_UNRESOLVED 422 A reference could not be resolved – SETTINGS_INVALID 422 Settings do not match their schema – BINDING_INVALID 422 The data binding is invalid – SPLIT_INVALID 422 The train/holdout split is invalid – LEAKAGE_RISK 422 A stateful step runs before the split – DIM_POLICY_LOOSENED 422 A dim policy may only be tightened – SCHEMA_DYNAMIC 422 Schema needs a dry-run to resolve – SIDE_TABLE_COVERAGE 422 A side table is not available – PLOT_UNSAFE 422 The plot spec violates the plot safety policy – GUIDED_ANSWERS_INVALID 422 The guided answers do not fit the template – BUSINESS_PRIORS_INVALID 422 The business priors are inconsistent – IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED 422 The imported model uses an unsupported feature –

docs.title: Score-time coordinate checks (CoordPlan)
docs.text: Code HTTP Meaning Retryable UNSEEN_LEVELS 422 Unseen levels on a dim that forbids them – COORD_NOT_ALLOWED 422 Coordinates not allowed by dim policy – HORIZON_EXCEEDS_FIT 409 Horizon exceeds the fitted range – MISSING_FUTURE_COVARIATE 422 A future covariate is missing – NON_CONTIGUOUS_EXTENSION 422 Extension is not contiguous – CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED 422 The model lacks this capability – RECURSIVE_UNSUPPORTED 422 Recursive forecasting unsupported –

docs.title: Capabilities
docs.text: Code HTTP Meaning Retryable MODE_NOT_SUPPORTED 422 Score mode not supported – CALIBRATION_UNSUPPORTED 422 The model cannot use this calibration data – SCENARIO_OUT_OF_RANGE 422 The scenario is outside the precomputed grid –

docs.title: Quotas
docs.text: Code HTTP Meaning Retryable QUOTA_EXCEEDED 429 Quota exceeded – RATE_LIMITED 429 Too many requests yes

docs.title: API
docs.text: Code HTTP Meaning Retryable UNAUTHENTICATED 401 Authentication required – FORBIDDEN 403 Not allowed – NOT_FOUND 404 Not found – CONFLICT 409 Conflict – IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT 409 Idempotency key reused – PRECONDITION_FAILED 412 Precondition failed – PROMOTION_BLOCKED 409 Promotion blocked by the scorecard – OVERRIDE_REQUIRED 409 Promotion needs an administrator override with a reason – WEBHOOK_URL_BLOCKED 422 The webhook URL is not allowed by the egress policy – WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID 401 Webhook signature invalid – EMBED_NOT_ALLOWED 422 Only platform plot recipes can be embedded – LINK_EXPIRED 410 The link has expired or was revoked – EMAIL_NOT_ALLOWED 422 This e-mail address cannot sign up – TERMS_NOT_ACCEPTED 422 The terms of service were not accepted – EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED 403 The e-mail address is not verified – IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED 403 Identity verification is required –

docs.title: Run failures
docs.text: Code HTTP Meaning Retryable USER_CODE_ERROR 422 User or plugin code failed – RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED 507 Run exhausted its resources – INFRA_ERROR 503 Infrastructure error yes INTEGRITY_FAILURE 500 Output integrity check failed – TIMEOUT 504 Run timed out – SANDBOX_VIOLATION 422 Sandbox policy violated – CANCELLED 409 Run was cancelled –

docs.title: Internal
docs.text: Code HTTP Meaning Retryable INTERNAL_ERROR 500 Internal error yes

docs.title: choice.multinomial_logit
docs.text:
Which product customers choose on each shopping trip: a conditional (multinomial) logit over alternative-specific covariates such as price and promotion, with household-specific product preferences. Uncertainty comes from the Bayesian bootstrap over households; new households draw their preferences from the fitted spread.

Version 1.0.0 Inference bootstrap Representation draws Score modes counterfactual, evaluate, forecast, predict Contributions none Decision objective – Fast scoring – Owns – LOO invalid: bootstrap draws have no pointwise log-likelihood Default plots core.data_overview, core.posterior_forest Resources class S (min S)

Outputs

Output Dims Units Description y_hat (hh, trip, product) probability Choice probability of each product per household and trip (predictive: one sampled choice, one-hot)

Settings (model.settings)

Field Type Default Level Description covariates list of string (optional) null advanced Alternative-specific variables along product (default: every numeric variable with the product dim) random_effects list of hh ["hh"] advanced Household-specific product intercepts ([hh]) or none ([]) (max items 1) effect_sd number 1.0 advanced Prior sd of the household effects (smaller pools households more) (> 0, ≤ 10) coef_sd number 10.0 advanced Prior sd of the product intercepts and coefficients (weak) (> 0, ≤ 1000) reference string (optional) null advanced Product whose intercept is fixed at 0 (default: the first label) max_iter integer 500 advanced ≥ 10, ≤ 10000 Input data contract (schema template) 
{
  "params": {
    "covariates": {
      "type": "string_list",
      "path": "covariates",
      "default": []
    }
  },
  "template": {
    "dims": {
      "hh": {
        "kind": "categorical",
        "policy": "new_levels",
        "new_level_strategy": "hyperprior"
      },
      "trip": {
        "kind": "index",
        "policy": "extend"
      },
      "product": {
        "kind": "categorical",
        "policy": "fixed"
      }
    },
    "vars": {
      "y": {
        "dims": [
          "hh",
          "trip"
        ],
        "dtype": "str",
        "role": "target",
        "missing": "allow"
      },
      "{*covariates as v}": {
        "dims": [
          "hh",
          "trip",
          "product"
        ],
        "dtype": "float64",
        "role": "covariate",
        "missing": "allow"
      }
    }
  }
}

docs.title: mmm.bayesinsight
docs.text:
A BayesInsight model_def.json as a built-in model: Normal, log-normal, Poisson, negative binomial and zero-inflated likelihoods, coefficient priors in KPI units, Hill, linear and S-shaped curves with delayed, geometric or Weibull carry-over, sign constraints, fixed and partially pooled effects per row id, Fourier seasons and local spline trends.

Version 1.0.0 Inference mcmc Representation draws Score modes counterfactual, evaluate, forecast, predict, simulate Contributions additive Decision objective – Fast scoring – Owns – LOO valid Default plots core.ppc_fan, core.convergence, core.posterior_forest Resources class M (min S)

Outputs

Output Dims Units Description y_hat (time) of y Expected (or predictive) KPI over the panel dims and time contributions (component, time) of y Media, baseline (intercepts), controls, seasons and trends in KPI units; they sum to the expected KPI (log-mean Divisia split for log links)

Settings (model.settings)

Field Type Default Level Description model_def BayesInsightModel required advanced BayesInsight's model_def.json (variable_details); priors in KPI units variables map of string required advanced Analytic variable name -> model-stage variable (the KPI is 'y') media list of string – advanced Model-stage media variables (lag tensors), in model_def order (max items 128) controls list of string – advanced Model-stage control variables, in model_def order (max items 256) row_dims map of string – advanced BayesInsight row id -> panel dim of the model-stage data panel list of string – advanced The panel dims (row_dims in BayesInsight's row order) (max items 5) l_max integer 12 advanced Carry-over lags (the lag tensor's l_max) (≥ 1, ≤ 104) lag_dim string lag advanced Lag dim of the media tensors Nested settings types Input data contract (schema template) 
{
  "params": {
    "panel": {
      "type": "string_list",
      "default": []
    },
    "media": {
      "type": "string_list",
      "default": []
    },
    "controls": {
      "type": "string_list",
      "default": []
    },
    "lag_dim": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "lag"
    }
  },
  "template": {
    "dims": {
      "time": {
        "kind": "time",
        "policy": "extend"
      },
      "{*panel as d}": {
        "kind": "categorical",
        "policy": "new_levels",
        "new_level_strategy": "pooled"
      },
      "{lag_dim}": {
        "kind": "integer",
        "policy": "fixed"
      }
    },
    "vars": {
      "y": {
        "dims": [
          "{*panel}",
          "time"
        ],
        "dtype": "float64",
        "role": "target",
        "missing": "allow"
      },
      "{*media as v}": {
        "dims": [
          "{*panel}",
          "time",
          "{lag_dim}"
        ],
        "dtype": "float64",
        "role": "spend",
        "missing": "allow"
      },
      "{*controls as v}": {
        "dims": [
          "{*panel}",
          "time"
        ],
        "dtype": "float64",
        "role": "control",
        "missing": "allow"
      }
    }
  }
}

model_def.json as the plugin runs it (artifact, fitted and VOF are local-fit bookkeeping and are dropped).

docs.title: CoeffPrior
docs.text:
A coefficient prior: a distribution and its parameters (BayesInsight's coeff_dist/coeff_params; coef_params is accepted as a misspelling).

Field Type Default Description coeff_dist string required coeff_params map of number required

docs.title: DelayedAdstockPrior
docs.text:
alpha ~ Beta(mu=retention_rate_mean, nu=retention_rate_std) and theta ~ Exponential(lam=lag_max) (BayesInsight's DelayedAdStockPrior; lag_min is kept but unused, as in BayesInsight). Geometric adstock uses the retention prior alone.

Field Type Default Description type Delayed Delayed retention_rate_mean number 0.2 > 0, < 1 retention_rate_std number 10.0 > 0 lag_min number 0.0001 > 0 lag_max number 3.0 > 0

docs.title: DeterministicTransform
docs.text:
A transform with known parameters: linear x, log log(x), exp 1 - exp(-x / alpha), indexp 1 - exp(-x / mean * alpha), power x^alpha (BayesInsight's DeterministicTransform).

Field Type Default Description functional_form linear or log or exp or indexp or power linear params map of number (optional) null

docs.title: HillPrior
docs.text:
K ~ LogNormal(log K_ave, log(K_std / K_ave + 1)) and n = 1 + Exponential(1 / (n_ave - 1)) (BayesInsight's HillPrior; n_std is kept but unused, as in BayesInsight, and n_ave must exceed 1).

Field Type Default Description type Hill Hill K_ave number 0.85 > 0 K_std number 0.6 > 0 n_ave number 1.5 > 1 n_std number 1.2 > 0

docs.title: Likelihood
docs.text:
The KPI's likelihood. likelihood_params parametrise the dispersion prior: sigma ~ HalfNormal(**params) (Normal, LogNormal; default sigma=1), alpha ~ Gamma(**params) (negative binomials; default alpha=2, beta=0.001) or psi ~ Beta(**params) (zero-inflated Poisson; default alpha=1, beta=1). The zero-inflated negative binomial takes alpha from the params and psi ~ Beta(1, 1). dispersion_dims give sigma/alpha one value per level of those row ids.

Field Type Default Description type Normal or LogNormal or Poisson or NegativeBinomial or ZeroInflatedPoisson or ZeroInflatedNegativeBinomial required likelihood_params map of number (optional) null dispersion_dims list of Geography or Product or Outlet or Campaign or Creative (optional) null

docs.title: LocalTrendPrior
docs.text:
BayesInsight's LocalTrendPrior (variability: the random walk's step scale, group_variablility - spelled as in BayesInsight - the spread of levels around the shared walk, partial_pooling the spread within a group, initial_dist_var the sd of the walk's first value).

Field Type Default Description type LocalTrend LocalTrend variability number 0.2 > 0 group_variablility number 0.01 > 0 partial_pooling number 0.01 > 0 initial_dist_var number 1.0 > 0

docs.title: SShapedPrior
docs.text:
alpha ~ Beta(mu=alpha_ave, sigma=alpha_std) and beta = 10^(8 beta_) with beta_ ~ Beta(mu=log10(beta_ave) / 8, sigma=log10(beta_std) / 8) (BayesInsight's SShapedPrior).

Field Type Default Description type SShaped SShaped alpha_ave number 0.88 > 0, < 1 alpha_std number 0.03 > 0 beta_ave number 100.0 > 1, < 100000000.0 beta_std number 1000.0 > 1

PDF weights are the density at lags 1..l_max scaled to [0, 1]; CDF weights the survival products starting at 1.

docs.title: mmm.hierarchical_geo
docs.text:
Hierarchical geo marketing-mix model: geometric/delayed adstock over a lag tensor, logistic or Hill saturation, channel effects partially pooled across geos, new geos drawn from the hyperprior, additive contributions, response curves and marginal costs in original units, and a budget objective for optimisation.

Version 1.3.0 Inference mcmc Representation draws Score modes counterfactual, evaluate, forecast, predict, simulate Contributions additive Decision objective yes Fast scoring yes Owns – LOO valid Default plots core.ppc_fan, core.convergence, core.posterior_forest, mmm.decomposition, mmm.response_curves, mmm.marginal_cost Resources class M (min S)

Outputs

Output Dims Units Description y_hat (geo, time) of y Expected (or predictive) target contributions (component, geo, time) of y Additive contribution of each channel, the baseline and each control; sums to y_hat

Derived quantities (outputs.derived)

Name Dims Units Cached Description contributions (sample, channel, geo, time) target fit Channel, baseline and control contributions over the fit window per thinned draw, in original units response_curves (sample, channel, multiplier, geo) target fit Total contribution per spend multiplier, channel and geo per thinned draw (Guided-mode slider grids) marginal_cost (sample, channel, geo) spend per target fit Extra spend per extra unit of the target at current spend

Field Type Default Level Description pooling partial or complete or none partial basic How channel effects are shared across geos: partial pooling (default), one effect for all geos, or independent geos (no new geos at score time) centred boolean false advanced Centred parameterisation of the geo-level effects (non-centred samples better with few geos or little data per geo) adstock AdstockSettings {"kind": "geometric", "l_max": null, "normalize": true} basic saturation SaturationSettings {"kind": "logistic"} basic priors Priors {"intercept": null, "intercept_sigma": null, "beta_channel"… advanced Prior overrides by parameter (pymc-marketing Prior dict form) controls list of string (optional) null advanced Control variables (default: every other numeric variable along time) lag_dim string lag advanced Lag dim of the spend tensor grid GridSettings {"max_multiplier": 2.0, "points": 21, "marginal_step": 0.01} advanced Nested settings types Input data contract (schema template)

        "kind": "time",

docs.title: ConformalUncertainty
docs.text:
Split-conformal prediction intervals (representation interval, never draws). A calibration fraction of the training rows is held out (the most recent periods of time_dim for calibration_by: last, a seeded random subset for random); the interval is point ± q where q is the ceil((n+1)(1-alpha))-th smallest absolute calibration residual. refit refits the point model on all rows afterwards (sharper, but the finite-sample guarantee then only holds approximately).

Field Type Default Description kind conformal conformal alpha number 0.1 > 0, < 1 calibration number 0.2 ≥ 0.05, ≤ 0.5 calibration_by last or random last refit boolean false

docs.title: sklearn.tabular_regressor
docs.text:
Tabular regression with an allow-listed scikit-learn or xgboost estimator: rows are stacked from labelled dims, predictions are point estimates (with exact linear or counterfactual-zeroing contributions).

Version 1.0.0 Inference point Representation point Score modes counterfactual, evaluate, forecast, predict Contributions none Decision objective – Fast scoring – Owns – LOO invalid: scikit-learn and xgboost estimators provide no pointwise log-likelihood Default plots – Resources class S (min S)

Outputs

Output Dims Units Description y_hat () – Prediction of the target over the row dims (settings.rows) contributions (component) – Per-feature contributions (exact for linear estimators, counterfactual zeroing otherwise), in model space

Settings (model.settings)

Field Type Default Level Description estimator LinearRegressionChoice or RidgeChoice or LassoChoice or ElasticNetChoice or QuantileRegressorChoice or LogisticRegressionChoice or RandomForestRegressorChoice or RandomForestClassifierChoice or GradientBoostingRegressorChoice or HistGradientBoostingRegressorChoice or XGBRegressorChoice or XGBClassifierChoice required – target string y – rows list of string required – min items 1, max items 8 time_dim string time – time_kind time or integer or index or none time – columns ColumnsSettings – – coord_features map of category or onehot or ordinal or numeric – – new_levels pooled or zero or error pooled – pooled_max_levels integer 256 – ≥ 1, ≤ 10000 weight string (optional) null – mask string (optional) null – forecast_strategy direct or recursive direct – retransform median or smearing median – n_jobs integer 1 – ≥ 1, ≤ 64 uncertainty NoUncertainty – – contributions none or auto or exact or zeroing auto – Nested settings types Input data contract (schema template) 
{
  "params": {
    "target": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "y"
    },
    "rows": {
      "type": "string_list",
      "required": true
    },
    "time_dim": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "time"
    },
    "time_kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "time",
        "integer",
        "index",
        "none"
      ],
      "default": "time"
    },
    "new_levels": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "pooled",
        "zero",
        "error"
      ],
      "default": "pooled"
    }
  },
  "template": {
    "dims": {
      "{*rows as d}": {
        "kind": "categorical",
        "policy": "new_levels",
        "new_level_strategy": "{new_levels}"
      }
    },
    "vars": {
      "{target}": {
        "dims": "{rows}",
        "dtype": "float64",
        "role": "target",
        "missing": "allow"
      }
    }
  },
  "cases": [
    {
      "when": {
        "time_kind": "time"
      },
      "merge": {
        "dims": {
          "{time_dim}": {
            "kind": "time",
            "policy": "extend",
            "new_level_strategy": "error"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "when": {
        "time_kind": "integer"
      },
      "merge": {
        "dims": {
          "{time_dim}": {
            "kind": "integer",
            "policy": "extend",
            "new_level_strategy": "error"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "when": {
        "time_kind": "index"
      },
      "merge": {
        "dims": {
          "{time_dim}": {
            "kind": "index",
            "policy": "extend",
            "new_level_strategy": "error"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}

docs.title: tabular.hierarchical_glm
docs.text:
A hierarchical generalised linear model in long layout: group intercepts (and optional slopes) partially pooled towards a population mean that may depend on group-level covariates. Unseen groups are drawn from the fitted hyperprior.

Version 1.0.0 Inference mcmc Representation draws Score modes counterfactual, evaluate, predict Contributions none Decision objective – Fast scoring – Owns – LOO valid Default plots core.ppc, core.convergence, core.posterior_forest Resources class S (min S)

Outputs

Output Dims Units Description y_hat (obs) of y Expected response (mean) or a predictive draw per observation

Settings (model.settings)

Field Type Default Level Description group_dim string county – The grouping dim (index var: _idx) family normal or student_t or poisson or bernoulli normal – Likelihood family (its canonical link) covariates list of string [] – Observation-level predictors over obs (max items 256) varying_slopes list of string [] – Covariates whose slope varies by group (max items 32) group_covariates list of string [] – Group-level predictors of the group intercept (max items 64) centered boolean false – Centred group effects (non-centred default) intercept_sigma number 2.0 – Prior sd of the population intercept (> 0) group_sigma_scale number 1.0 – Half-normal scale of group sds (> 0) beta_sigma number 1.0 – Prior sd of the population slopes (> 0) noise_sigma number 1.0 – Half-normal scale of the noise sd (> 0) Input data contract (schema template) 
{
  "params": {
    "group_dim": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "county"
    },
    "covariates": {
      "type": "string_list",
      "default": []
    },
    "group_covariates": {
      "type": "string_list",
      "default": []
    }
  },
  "template": {
    "layout": "long",
    "dims": {
      "obs": {
        "kind": "integer",
        "policy": "extend"
      },
      "{group_dim}": {
        "kind": "categorical",
        "policy": "new_levels",
        "new_level_strategy": "hyperprior"
      }
    },
    "vars": {
      "y": {
        "dims": [
          "obs"
        ],
        "dtype": "float64",
        "role": "target"
      },
      "{group_dim}_idx": {
        "dims": [
          "obs"
        ],
        "dtype": "int64",
        "role": "index",
        "index_of": "{group_dim}"
      },
      "{*covariates as v}": {
        "dims": [
          "obs"
        ],
        "dtype": "float64",
        "role": "covariate"
      },
      "{*group_covariates as v}": {
        "dims": [
          "{group_dim}"
        ],
        "dtype": "float64",
        "role": "covariate"
      }
    }
  }
}

docs.title: ts.gaussian_hmm
docs.text:
A K-state Gaussian hidden Markov model over padded sequences (e.g. animal tracks). Hidden states are marginalised with the forward algorithm; forecasts and filters start from the stored terminal state.

Version 1.0.0 Inference mcmc Representation draws Score modes evaluate, filter, forecast, predict Contributions none Decision objective – Fast scoring – Owns – LOO invalid: the HMM likelihood is a potential over whole sequences; steps within a sequence are dependent, so pointwise leave-one-out is not defined Default plots core.convergence, core.posterior_forest Resources class S (min S)

Outputs

Output Dims Units Description y_hat (animal, step) of y One-step-ahead expected value or predictive draw of y state_prob (animal, step, state) probability Hidden-state probabilities (predicted, or filtered in filter mode)

Settings (model.settings)

Field Type Default Level Description n_states integer 2 – Number of hidden states K (≥ 2, ≤ 8) mu_center number 0.0 – Prior mean of the state means mu_sigma number 2.0 – Prior sd of the state means (> 0) sigma_scale number 1.0 – Half-normal scale of the emission sds (> 0) stickiness number 2.0 – Extra Dirichlet weight on staying in the same state (≥ 0, ≤ 1000) pi_concentration number 1.0 – Dirichlet weight of pi (> 0) identification relabel or ordered relabel – relabel: sort states by mean after sampling; ordered: ordered prior Input data contract (schema template) 
{
  "template": {
    "dims": {
      "animal": {
        "kind": "categorical",
        "policy": "new_levels",
        "new_level_strategy": "pooled"
      },
      "step": {
        "kind": "integer",
        "policy": "extend"
      }
    },
    "vars": {
      "y": {
        "dims": [
          "animal",
          "step"
        ],
        "dtype": "float64",
        "role": "target",
        "missing": "allow"
      },
      "mask": {
        "dims": [
          "animal",
          "step"
        ],
        "dtype": "bool",
        "role": "mask"
      }
    },
    "ragged": [
      {
        "group_dim": "animal",
        "within_dim": "step",
        "form": "padded",
        "mask_var": "mask"
      }
    ]
  }
}

docs.title: ts.hsgp_trend
docs.text:
A smooth Hilbert-space GP trend with optional linear drift and Fourier seasonality for one regular time series (Mauna-Loa style). Forecasts reach at most max_extension periods past the fit; further horizons need a refit.

Version 1.0.0 Inference mcmc Representation draws Score modes evaluate, forecast, predict Contributions none Decision objective – Fast scoring – Owns – LOO valid Default plots core.ppc_fan, core.convergence, core.posterior_forest Resources class S (min S)

Outputs

Output Dims Units Description y_hat (t) of y The series: expected value (trend + seasonality) or a predictive draw trend (t) of y The long-term component (intercept + drift + GP), no seasonality

Settings (model.settings)

Field Type Default Level Description max_extension integer 24 – Periods a forecast may reach past the fitted range without a refit; sizes the HSGP domain (x-ui-level: basic) (≥ 1, ≤ 10000) kernel expquad or matern52 or matern32 expquad – Covariance kernel of the smooth trend m integer 30 – Number of HSGP basis functions (≥ 4, ≤ 400) c number 1.5 – Boundary factor (L = c on the scaled axis) (> 1.0, ≤ 5.0) lengthscale_mu number 0.4 – Median of the lengthscale prior on the scaled axis [-1, 1] (> 0) lengthscale_sigma number 0.5 – Log-scale sd of the lengthscale (> 0) eta_sigma number 1.0 – Half-normal scale of the GP amplitude (> 0) linear_trend boolean true – intercept_sigma number 1.0 – > 0 slope_sigma number 1.0 – > 0 season_period number (optional) 12.0 – Seasonal period in periods of t (12 for monthly data) season_order integer 3 – Fourier order of the seasonality (≥ 0, ≤ 20) season_sigma number 0.5 – > 0 noise_sigma number 0.5 – > 0 Input data contract (schema template) 
{
  "params": {
    "max_extension": {
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 24
    }
  },
  "template": {
    "dims": {
      "t": {
        "kind": "time",
        "policy": "extend",
        "max_extension": "{max_extension}"
      }
    },
    "vars": {
      "y": {
        "dims": [
          "t"
        ],
        "dtype": "float64",
        "role": "target",
        "missing": "allow"
      }
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Permissions
docs.text: The authorization rules of the platform, generated from mapi_spec.tenancy and mapi_spec.tokens by scripts/gen_docs_platform.py. Every component (the API, the web app through OpenAPI, the tests) checks the same table. The Administration guide explains how to use it.

docs.title: Roles
docs.text:
Roles are ordered viewer < editor < runner < admin; each includes the one before it. tenant-wide means only a tenant-wide membership grants it; otherwise the effective role in the project counts (the higher of the tenant-wide and the project grant). A pair that is not listed is denied to everyone.

docs.title: Operators
docs.text: Platform operators (verified e-mails in MAPI_OPERATOR_EMAILS, signed in; never through an API token) hold exactly these permissions, on every tenant: audit read, billing read, catalog read, executor read, executor update, kill_switch read, kill_switch update, member read, project read, quota delete, quota read, quota update, run read, tenant_deletion manage, tenant_deletion read, tenant_member read, tenant create, tenant delete, tenant manage, tenant read, token read, usage read. None of them reads tenant content: datasets, specs, models or plots.

docs.title: Token scopes
docs.text:
A token acts as its owner, narrowed by its scopes: both the owner's role and a scope must allow an action. admin covers everything the owner's role allows; score:<alias> covers one endpoint (score:* every endpoint of the project).

docs.title: Server settings
docs.text:
Every setting of mapi-server (api, worker, migrate, dev), generated from mapi_server.settings.Settings by scripts/gen_docs_reference.py. Each field reads the environment variable MAPI_<FIELD>; .env files are not read. The configuration reference explains them by task and lists the variables of the other components.

Variable Type Default Description MAPI_ENV str local Selects bucket names mapi-{env}-* MAPI_PROFILE single-tenant | multi-tenant | dev single-tenant MAPI_TENANT_ID str default MAPI_PROJECT_ID str default MAPI_DEBUG bool False Include tracebacks in problem.untrusted_text MAPI_API_HOST str 127.0.0.1 MAPI_API_PORT int 8000 MAPI_API_URL str http://127.0.0.1:8000 MAPI_WEB_ORIGIN str http://127.0.0.1:5173 MAPI_PLOTS_ORIGIN str http://127.0.0.1:5174 MAPI_DATA_DIR Path .local MAPI_ALLOWED_HOSTS list (computed) Host header values the API answers (comma-separated in the environment; '*' turns the check off). The host of api_url is always allowed. The API is unauthenticated in M1, so this is what stops DNS-rebinding pages from using it. MAPI_DATABASE_URL or DATABASE_URL str \| None unset postgresql:// URL; unset = embedded pgserver under data_dir/pg MAPI_DB_POOL_SIZE int 10 MAPI_DB_SYSTEM_POOL_SIZE int 5 MAPI_DB_GATEWAY_POOL_SIZE int 5 MAPI_DB_ECHO bool False MAPI_DATABASE_APP_URL str \| None unset Login of the request-path role (row-level security applies). Unset: connect with DATABASE_URL and SET ROLE db_app_role on every connection MAPI_DATABASE_SYSTEM_URL str \| None unset Login of the platform role: the orchestrator's dispatcher, reconciler, finalizer and housekeeper (bypasses row-level security; the API never needs it). Unset: DATABASE_URL with SET ROLE db_system_role MAPI_DATABASE_GATEWAY_URL str \| None unset Login of the gateway role: what the API and events service look up before a tenant is known (sign-in, memberships, operator metadata, pushed events; row-level security applies). Unset: DATABASE_URL with SET ROLE db_gateway_role MAPI_DB_APP_ROLE str mapi_app MAPI_DB_SYSTEM_ROLE str mapi_system MAPI_DB_GATEWAY_ROLE str mapi_gateway MAPI_OBJECT_STORE shim | memory | gcs shim MAPI_GCS_ENDPOINT str http://127.0.0.1:4443 MAPI_GCS_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT str \| None unset Base URL put into signed URLs when executions/browsers reach the shim under another host name (default: gcs_endpoint) MAPI_GCP_PROJECT str \| None unset Google Cloud project of the Cloud Storage client (MAPI_OBJECT_STORE=gcs) MAPI_URL_SIGNER str \| None unset Service account that signs Cloud Storage URLs through IAM signBlob (keyless; required with MAPI_OBJECT_STORE=gcs) MAPI_URL_UPLOADER str \| None unset Service account that signs create-only upload policies (objects.create, never delete; required with MAPI_OBJECT_STORE=gcs and distinct from url_signer) MAPI_GCS_ROOT Path \| None unset The GCS shim's state directory (default: data_dir/gcs) MAPI_GCS_KEY_FILE Path \| None unset Key file of the shim's control principal (default: gcs_root/_shim/keys/control.json) MAPI_EXEC_TOKEN str \| None unset Bearer token of the shim's exec principal (local executors only; default: read from gcs_root/_shim/keys/exec.json) MAPI_EXECUTOR local-process | docker | docker-gvisor | cloudrun-jobs local-process MAPI_RUNNER_COMMAND list (computed) argv of the supervisor (shell-quoted string in the environment) MAPI_DOCKER_IMAGE str mapi/base-bayes:0.4.0 Runner image for runs without a mapped plugin (ingest, describe, ...) MAPI_DOCKER_IMAGES dict (computed) Plugin namespace → runner image (JSON in the environment) MAPI_DOCKER_NETWORK str none Network of run containers: 'container:' (share the shim's namespace, so 127.0.0.1:4443 works) or an internal network holding only the shim. 'none' is refused while the bootstrap URL is HTTP (nothing would be reachable). MAPI_DOCKER_NETWORK_ISOLATED bool False Declare MAPI_DOCKER_NETWORK an internal network that holds only the GCS shim (no route out, no DNS beyond it), so docker-gvisor reports enforced egress and DNS. Shared tiers still need a passing security-suite run recorded for these caps MAPI_DOCKER_RUNTIME_GVISOR str runsc MAPI_EXECUTOR_WORKDIR Path \| None unset MAPI_CANCEL_GRACE_S float 10.0 MAPI_CLOUDRUN_PROJECT str \| None unset Exec project that holds the Cloud Run Job inventory (cloudrun-jobs) MAPI_CLOUDRUN_REGION str europe-west1 Region of the Job inventory MAPI_DEFAULT_RESIDENCY str \| None unset Data residency of the platform tenant, of tenants adopted by the migrations and of tenants created without one (default: the multi-region of MAPI_CLOUDRUN_REGION for cloudrun-jobs, e.g. eu, else us) MAPI_CLOUDRUN_JOB_TEMPLATE str mapi-{env}-{base}-{class} Job id convention; {env}, {base} (base-bayes|base-ml|base-forecast) and {class} (s|m|l) are substituted. Must match the Jobs Terraform creates MAPI_CLOUDRUN_PLUGIN_BASES dict (computed) Plugin namespace → base image family (JSON in the environment) MAPI_CLOUDRUN_DEFAULT_BASE str base-bayes Base for runs without a mapped plugin (ingest, describe) MAPI_CLOUDRUN_SUBMITS_PER_MINUTE float 150.0 Token-bucket rate of jobs.run calls per orchestrator; the regional quota is 180/min [verify M0], so split it between orchestrator replicas MAPI_CLOUDRUN_SUBMIT_BURST int 10 MAPI_CLOUDRUN_MAX_429_RETRIES int 6 429 answers before giving up MAPI_CLOUDRUN_BACKOFF_BASE_S float 1.0 MAPI_CLOUDRUN_BACKOFF_CAP_S float 64.0 MAPI_CLOUDRUN_TIMEOUT_MARGIN_S int 120 Task timeout = run timeout + margin (the supervisor flushes) MAPI_CLOUDRUN_EGRESS_ENFORCED bool True The exec network denies all egress except the restricted VIP MAPI_CLOUDRUN_DNS_ENFORCED bool False The DNS response policy is verified to apply to Jobs [verify M0]; verified and public tenants are only placed when both egress and DNS are enforced (and suite evidence is recorded) MAPI_CLOUDRUN_ADOPT_LOOKBACK_S float 93600 How far back orphan adoption lists executions MAPI_PUBSUB_PUSH_AUDIENCE str \| None unset Expected audience of the Pub/Sub push OIDC token (usually the push endpoint URL). When set, POST /internal/events requires a Google-signed token MAPI_PUBSUB_PUSH_SERVICE_ACCOUNT str \| None unset Service account the push subscription signs its tokens as MAPI_PUBSUB_PUSH_SUBSCRIPTIONS list (computed) Accepted subscription names (comma-separated; empty = any) MAPI_GOOGLE_JWKS_URL str https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/certs JWKS of Google's OIDC signing keys (push token verification) MAPI_DISPATCH_RATE_PER_MINUTE float 180.0 MAPI_DISPATCH_BURST int 10 MAPI_DISPATCH_BATCH int 10 MAPI_DISPATCH_POLL_S float 1.0 MAPI_DISPATCH_LEASE_S float 120.0 MAPI_DISPATCH_TIERS list (computed) Trust tiers whose runs this orchestrator leases (comma-separated); empty: every tier. Give each orchestrator a disjoint list when several serve different exec pools, so tenant tiers never share a pool MAPI_RECONCILE_INTERVAL_S float 10.0 MAPI_STALL_INTERVALS int 15 K: silence > K x progress interval MAPI_COMPLETE_EVENT_GRACE_S float 60.0 MAPI_LOST_EXECUTION_GRACE_S float 60.0 MAPI_MAX_INFRA_RETRIES int 2 MAPI_AUTO_RETRY_WINDOW_S float 1800.0 No auto-retry beyond 30 min MAPI_AUTO_RETRY_COST_FACTOR float 2.0 No auto-retry once a run's metered cost reaches this multiple of its estimate (plan §8.3: retries capped by cost) MAPI_FINALIZE_MAX_ATTEMPTS int 5 MAPI_DEADLINE_GRACE_S float 60.0 MAPI_HOUSEKEEPING_INTERVAL_S float 300.0 Sweep of expired upload intents and other expiring rows MAPI_CATALOG_PATH Path \| None unset Catalog JSON exported at image build (runner describe) MAPI_IMAGE_DIGEST str \| None unset MAPI_UV_LOCK_PATH Path \| None unset MAPI_SIGNING_KEY_PATH Path \| None unset PEM of the bundle-signing key (default: data_dir/keys/bundle-signing-p256.pem); every process that signs or verifies bundles must share it MAPI_SIGNING_TRUSTED_KEY_PATHS list (computed) PEM files (public or private) of retired bundle-signing keys whose signatures still verify (comma-separated): key rotation without invalidating the bundles the old key signed MAPI_SIGNING_KEY_CREATE bool True Create the signing key when it is missing; off where mapi-server migrate creates it on shared storage (compose api/worker) MAPI_SIGNER local | kms local local = PEM key file; kms = Cloud KMS asymmetric key MAPI_KMS_KEY_VERSION str \| None unset projects/…/cryptoKeys/…/cryptoKeyVersions/N that signs bundle manifests MAPI_KMS_TRUSTED_KEY_VERSIONS list (computed) Older key versions whose signatures still verify (comma-separated) MAPI_INTERNAL_TOKEN str \| None unset If set, POST /internal/events requires this bearer MAPI_AUTH_REQUIRED bool \| None unset Require a session or API token on every non-public route (default: required in every profile except single-tenant) MAPI_SERVER_SECRET str \| None unset Root secret of the token pepper and audit fingerprints (default: read or create server-secret next to the bundle-signing key). Changing it invalidates every API token. MAPI_SERVER_SECRET_PATH Path \| None unset MAPI_COOKIE_SECURE bool \| None unset Secure, __Host- prefixed cookies (default: on when api_url is https) MAPI_OIDC_ISSUER str \| None unset OpenID Connect issuer (e.g. https://accounts.google.com) MAPI_OIDC_DISCOVERY_URL str \| None unset Default: /.well-known/openid-configuration MAPI_OIDC_CLIENT_ID str \| None unset MAPI_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET str \| None unset MAPI_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI str \| None unset Registered redirect URI (default: /auth/callback) MAPI_OIDC_ALGORITHMS list (computed) MAPI_OIDC_CLI_CLIENT_IDS list (computed) Client ids of public OIDC clients (the mapi CLI) whose ID tokens of the same issuer are accepted as bearers (comma-separated; empty: API tokens only) MAPI_OIDC_EXTRA_PARAMS dict (computed) Extra authorization parameters, e.g. {"hd": "acme.com"} (JSON) MAPI_OPERATOR_EMAILS list (computed) Verified e-mails that sign in as platform operators (comma-separated) MAPI_DEFAULT_TENANT_ADMINS list (computed) E-mails invited as admins of the default tenant at start-up (comma-separated; the invitation is claimed at first sign-in) MAPI_DEVIDP_USERS list (computed) Accounts of the development identity provider (MAPI_PROFILE=dev only) MAPI_PRICE_TABLE_PATH Path \| None unset JSON PriceTable (default: mapi_spec.cost.DEFAULT_PRICE_TABLE) MAPI_ESTIMATE_WALL_S dict (computed) MAPI_RATE_LIMITS_ENABLED bool True MAPI_LEASE_CANDIDATES int 500 Queued runs the fair-share planner considers MAPI_LEASE_CANDIDATES_PER_TENANT int 50 At most this many of them per tenant (a tenant whose runs are held cannot fill the window) MAPI_EXECUTOR_REPORT_INTERVAL_S float 10.0 MAPI_EXECUTOR_EVIDENCE_MAX_AGE_S float 259200.0 How long a recorded conformance or security-suite report lets an executor take verified and public tenants (the nightly suites renew it) MAPI_SSE_HEARTBEAT_S float 15.0 MAPI_SSE_POLL_S float 5.0 Fallback poll when no NOTIFY arrives MAPI_SSE_REAUTH_S float 60.0 How often an open event stream re-checks its caller's credential (a revoked token, an expired session or a lost membership closes the stream) MAPI_MAX_SIDECAR_BYTES int 8388608 MAPI_LOG_LEVEL debug | info | warning | error info MAPI_RENDER_TIMEOUT_S int 300 Wall-clock limit of a POST /v1/plots:render run (the sandbox kills it) MAPI_RENDER_PLOTLY_ENABLED bool False Accept Plotly plots in POST /v1/plots:render. Plotly static export needs kaleido and a Chrome/Chromium in the runner image, which the base images do not ship; while off, Plotly renders are refused with MODE_NOT_SUPPORTED MAPI_EMBED_RATE_PER_MINUTE int 300 Public embed views per minute and embed link (429 beyond) MAPI_EMBED_IP_RATE_PER_MINUTE int 120 Public embed requests per minute and client address, valid or not MAPI_EMBED_CACHE_S float 60.0 How long an API instance reuses an embed's resolved plot (revocation and expiry are still checked on every request; responses are never cached by browsers or shared caches, so a revoked link stops rendering on the next load) MAPI_EMBED_IMAGE_URL_TTL_S int 900 Lifetime of the PNG fallback's signed URL MAPI_LOG_JSON bool True Emit JSON logs (structlog); off gives a human console renderer MAPI_TRUSTED_PROXIES list[str] \| None unset Addresses or CIDR ranges of the proxies in front of the API (load balancer, Cloud Run front end, the web container's /v1/ proxy), comma-separated. A request from one of them takes the right-most untrusted X-Forwarded-For hop as the client address (per-address limits, Sybil checks, audit). 'none': clients reach the API directly and X-Forwarded-For is ignored. Required in the multi-tenant profile MAPI_METRICS_ENABLED bool True Mount GET /metrics (Prometheus) MAPI_WORKER_METRICS_PORT int \| None unset Serve GET /metrics of the worker (dispatcher, reconciler, finalizer, events) on this port; unset: the worker exposes no metrics MAPI_WORKER_METRICS_HOST str 127.0.0.1 Bind address of the worker's metrics endpoint MAPI_METRICS_TOKEN str \| None unset Bearer a scraper must present on GET /metrics; required in the multi-tenant profile (the series carry tenant ids and spend) MAPI_TRACING_ENABLED bool True Install the OpenTelemetry tracer provider MAPI_OTLP_ENDPOINT str \| None unset OTLP/HTTP collector base URL for span export (also read from OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT); unset means spans are created but not exported MAPI_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_HTTP bool False Development only: allow http:// webhook URLs, for the hosts in MAPI_WEBHOOK_DEV_ALLOWLIST only (refused in the multi-tenant profile) MAPI_WEBHOOK_DEV_ALLOWLIST list (computed) Development only: webhook host names (comma-separated) exempt from the SSRF address and port checks, e.g. a receiver on localhost (refused in the multi-tenant profile) MAPI_WEBHOOK_CA_FILE Path \| None unset Extra PEM CA bundle trusted for webhook receivers (a private CA); the system trust store is always used MAPI_WEBHOOK_POLL_INTERVAL_S float 2.0 How often the worker looks for due webhook deliveries MAPI_WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS int 8 Tries per delivery (the retry schedule allows up to 8) MAPI_WEBHOOK_AUTO_DISABLE_AFTER int 20 Disable a webhook after this many consecutive events failed MAPI_WEBHOOK_MAX_PER_PROJECT int 25 MAPI_WEBHOOK_RETENTION_DAYS int 30 Days webhook events and their delivery logs are kept MAPI_SIGNUP_ENABLED bool \| None unset Self-service sign-up at POST /auth/signup (default: on in the dev and multi-tenant profiles when a mailer is configured, off single-tenant) MAPI_MAILER MailerKind \| None unset How e-mail is sent: console, outbox, smtp or none (default: outbox in dev, console single-tenant, smtp multi-tenant) MAPI_MAIL_FROM str modeling-api <no-reply@mapi.localhost> From: header of the e-mails the server sends MAPI_OUTBOX_DIR Path \| None unset Where the outbox mailer writes messages (default: data_dir/outbox) MAPI_SMTP_HOST str \| None unset SMTP server (MAPI_MAILER=smtp) MAPI_SMTP_PORT int 587 MAPI_SMTP_TLS starttls | ssl starttls starttls (port 587) or ssl (implicit TLS, port 465) MAPI_SMTP_USERNAME str \| None unset MAPI_SMTP_PASSWORD str \| None unset MAPI_SMTP_TIMEOUT_S float 10.0 MAPI_SIGNUP_VERIFY_URL str \| None unset Verification link template with {token} (default: /verify-email?token={token}) MAPI_SIGNUP_BLOCKED_DOMAINS list (computed) E-mail domains refused at sign-up besides the built-in disposable list (comma-separated; subdomains included) MAPI_SIGNUP_BLOCKLIST_PATH Path \| None unset A file of disposable e-mail domains (one per line, # comments), e.g. a maintained public list, added to the built-in one MAPI_SIGNUP_PER_IP_PER_HOUR int 5 Sign-ups accepted per client address and hour MAPI_SIGNUP_PER_DOMAIN_PER_DAY int 25 Verified sign-ups per e-mail domain and day (shared free-mail domains are exempt) MAPI_SIGNUP_GLOBAL_PER_HOUR int 500 Verified sign-ups per hour on the whole platform MAPI_SIGNUP_SHARED_EMAIL_DOMAINS list (computed) Free-mail domains shared by unrelated people (comma-separated; replaces the built-in list): no per-domain sign-up cap and no domain-burst Sybil flag MAPI_VERIFY_PER_IP_PER_MINUTE int 20 E-mail verification attempts per client address and minute MAPI_SIGNUP_SYBIL_WINDOW_DAYS int 30 Look-back of the Sybil heuristics (same address, browser, e-mail) MAPI_SIGNUP_SYBIL_THRESHOLD int 3 Workspaces created from one address, browser or e-mail within the window before a new one is flagged for review MAPI_SIGNUP_FLAGGED_SUSPEND bool False Suspend a flagged sign-up's tenant until an operator approves it (default: it works and waits in the review queue) MAPI_SIGNUP_RETENTION_DAYS int 30 Unverified sign-ups (with their e-mail) are deleted after this MAPI_PUBLIC_CODE_UPLOAD_ENABLED bool False Cut line B: let identity-verified public tenants run uploaded code (off through M4: public tenants run built-ins and declarative specs only) MAPI_TENANT_DELETION_GRACE_S float 604800.0 Grace period of a tenant deletion: the tenant is suspended and may cancel MAPI_DELETION_REAUTH_MAX_AGE_S float \| None unset Also require a sign-in at most this old to request a deletion (re-auth); unset: the confirmation phrase alone MAPI_DELETION_RUN_STOP_TIMEOUT_S float 3600.0 How long a purge waits for the tenant's cancelled runs to stop MAPI_DELETION_MAX_ATTEMPTS int 8 Automatic retries of a failed purge before operators must retry MAPI_BUNDLE_RETENTION_DAYS int 30 The bundles bucket's retention period (Terraform bundle_retention_days): when a purge may retry objects a retention lock refused MAPI_LIFECYCLE_INTERVAL_S float 15.0 Cadence of the deletion and export scheduler (orchestrator) MAPI_EXPORT_MAX_INLINE_BYTES int 268435456 Dataset bytes a GDPR export archive includes; larger exports list the remaining objects (with sizes and hashes) instead MAPI_EXPORT_RETENTION_S float 604800.0 How long a GDPR export archive is kept MAPI_EXPORT_LINK_TTL_S float 900.0 Lifetime of an export's signed download link MAPI_EXPORTS_PER_DAY int 3 GDPR exports a tenant may request per day MAPI_EXPORT_MAX_METADATA_BYTES int 268435456 Bytes of metadata rows (runs, logs, events, audit, ...) a GDPR export archive includes; the tables cut short are listed in its manifest MAPI_EXPORT_BUILD_TIMEOUT_S float 3600.0 How long one GDPR export build may take; a build still marked running 5 minutes after that (its process died) is built again once, then failed

docs.title: ModelSpec
docs.text:
The declarative modelling file.

Field Type Default Description apiVersion mapi/v1 required kind ModelSpec required metadata Metadata required data DataBlock required pipeline list of StepCall – max items 64 model ModelBlock required outputs OutputsBlock – evaluate EvaluateBlock – execution ExecutionBlock – calibration Calibration (optional) null Business priors and lift tests the model should respect (M3); needs a model whose capabilities declare them

docs.title: AsOfSplit
docs.text:
Train on coords up to and including as_of; hold out the rest (optionally gap).

Field Type Default Description after_step string (optional) null Stage the split happens at (a step id or 'raw'); default: end of the stateless prefix allow_leakage boolean false Downgrade LEAKAGE_RISK to a warning (acknowledged) kind as_of required dim string required as_of string or integer or number or boolean required gap integer 0 ≥ 0

docs.title: Binding
docs.text:
Canonical name → dataset name, for dims and variables (geo: market). Names that are not bound keep their dataset name. The binding is stored in the bundle and reversed on every output by default.

Field Type Default Description dims map of string – vars map of string –

docs.title: BusinessPriors
docs.text:
Beliefs in business units, per channel (keys are channel labels as in the data), and/or about the baseline. At least one belief is stated: a baseline belief alone is fine (channels without a belief keep the model's default priors).

Field Type Default Description channels map of ChannelBelief – baseline_share ShareBelief (optional) null kpi_units string (optional) null spend_units string (optional) null

docs.title: Calibration
docs.text:
The calibration block of a ModelSpec: beliefs and experiment results the model should respect. prior_translation_run records which translate_priors run produced the priors in model.settings.priors (lineage only).

Field Type Default Description business_priors BusinessPriors (optional) null lift_tests list of LiftTest – max items 500 prior_translation_run string (optional) null

docs.title: ChannelBelief
docs.text:
What the user believes about one channel: exactly one of roi or contribution_share, held with credibility. * roi: KPI units gained per spend unit over the fit window ([1.5, 4] = "every euro returns between 1.5 and 4 euros of revenue"); * contribution_share: the channel's share of the KPI over the fit window.

Field Type Default Description roi list of any (optional) null contribution_share list of any (optional) null credibility number 0.8 Probability that the true value lies inside the range (0.8 = 'I am 80% sure') (≥ 0.5, ≤ 0.99)

docs.title: Checkpoint
docs.text: Field Type Default Description every_draws integer required ≥ 1, ≤ 1000000

docs.title: DataBlock
docs.text:
The dataset, side tables, binding to canonical names and the split.

Field Type Default Description dataset string required Dataset reference dataset://project/name@version side_tables map of SideTable – bind Binding – split TimeHoldoutSplit or LastPerGroupSplit or AsOfSplit or LeaveGroupOutSplit or MaskBlockSplit (optional) null

docs.title: EvaluateBlock
docs.text: Field Type Default Description metrics list of string – max items 32

docs.title: ExecutionBlock
docs.text: Field Type Default Description resource_class ResourceClass S timeout string – Duration such as '45m', '1h30m' or '90s'.

docs.title: FitConfig
docs.text:
Platform fit settings. Plugin-specific limits come from the manifest's fit_schema.

Field Type Default Description mode FitMode evaluate_then_refit engine string (optional) null tune integer (optional) null draws integer (optional) null chains integer (optional) null target_accept number (optional) null seed integer (optional) null prior_predictive PriorPredictive (optional) null keep KeepConfig – checkpoint Checkpoint (optional) null

docs.title: FitMode
docs.text: One of evaluate_then_refit, train_only.

docs.title: JsonValue
docs.text: Type: any

docs.title: KeepConfig
docs.text:
Optional groups kept in the bundle.

Field Type Default Description log_likelihood boolean false posterior_predictive PosteriorPredictiveKeep or boolean false prior boolean false

docs.title: LastPerGroupSplit
docs.text:
Hold out the last last rows along dim within each group (min_len kept).

Field Type Default Description after_step string (optional) null Stage the split happens at (a step id or 'raw'); default: end of the stateless prefix allow_leakage boolean false Downgrade LEAKAGE_RISK to a warning (acknowledged) kind last_per_group required dim string required within list of string required min items 1, max items 8 last integer 1 ≥ 1 min_len integer 1 ≥ 1

docs.title: LeaveGroupOutSplit
docs.text:
Hold out whole groups of dim (explicit groups or n random ones).

Field Type Default Description after_step string (optional) null Stage the split happens at (a step id or 'raw'); default: end of the stateless prefix allow_leakage boolean false Downgrade LEAKAGE_RISK to a warning (acknowledged) kind leave_group_out required dim string required groups list of string or integer or number or boolean (optional) null n integer (optional) null seed integer (optional) null

docs.title: LiftTest
docs.text:
One experiment: spend_delta extra spend on channel (optionally in one geo) from start to end (inclusive) caused kpi_delta incremental KPI. Give the measurement's uncertainty as a standard error se or a confidence interval ci at ci_level. A holdout ("turn the channel off") is a negative spend_delta with (usually) a negative kpi_delta.

Field Type Default Description id string (optional) null channel string required geo string (optional) null start string required end string required spend_delta number required Extra spend during the test (spend units) kpi_delta number required Measured incremental KPI (KPI units) se number (optional) null Standard error of kpi_delta ci list of any (optional) null Confidence interval of kpi_delta ci_level number 0.9 ≥ 0.5, ≤ 0.999 description string (optional) null

docs.title: MaskBlockSplit
docs.text:
Hold out random blocks over dims (block sizes per dim) covering fraction.

Field Type Default Description after_step string (optional) null Stage the split happens at (a step id or 'raw'); default: end of the stateless prefix allow_leakage boolean false Downgrade LEAKAGE_RISK to a warning (acknowledged) kind mask_block required dims list of string required min items 1, max items 8 fraction number required > 0, < 1 block map of integer – seed integer (optional) null

docs.title: Metadata
docs.text:
Identity and labels of a document.

Field Type Default Description name string required project string required labels map of string – description string (optional) null

docs.title: ModelBlock
docs.text:
The model plugin, its settings and fit configuration. settings.dim_policies is platform-reserved: a mapping dim → policy that may only tighten the plugin's policies. It is removed before plugin settings validation.

Field Type Default Description use string required Registered id with an optional semver range settings map of JsonValue – fit FitConfig –

docs.title: OutputsBlock
docs.text: Field Type Default Description derived list of string – max items 64 plots list of string – max items 64 ui_draws integer 300 ≥ 0, ≤ 2000

docs.title: PosteriorPredictiveKeep
docs.text: Field Type Default Description thin integer 1 ≥ 1, ≤ 10000

docs.title: PriorPredictive
docs.text: Field Type Default Description draws integer required ≥ 1, ≤ 100000

docs.title: ResourceClass
docs.text:
Executor resource class. Ordered: S < M < L < XL.

One of S, M, L, XL.

docs.title: ScorePolicy
docs.text:
Which side-table version is used at score time.

One of pinned, latest, supplied.

docs.title: ShareBelief
docs.text:
A share range (for example of the baseline: KPI that happens without any media).

Field Type Default Description share list of any required min items 2, max items 2 credibility number 0.8 Probability that the true value lies inside the range (0.8 = 'I am 80% sure') (≥ 0.5, ≤ 0.99)

docs.title: SideTable
docs.text:
A small constant dataset (FX rates, holidays ...) used by steps.

Field Type Default Description ref string required Dataset reference dataset://project/name@version score_policy ScorePolicy pinned

docs.title: StepCall
docs.text:
One pipeline step: {id, use: core.resample@^1, with: {...settings}}.

Field Type Default Description id string required use string required Registered id with an optional semver range with map of JsonValue –

docs.title: TimeHoldoutSplit
docs.text:
Hold out the end of an ordered dim: last periods, a fraction or after a coord.

Field Type Default Description after_step string (optional) null Stage the split happens at (a step id or 'raw'); default: end of the stateless prefix allow_leakage boolean false Downgrade LEAKAGE_RISK to a warning (acknowledged) kind time_holdout required dim string required last integer (optional) null fraction number (optional) null after string or integer or number or boolean (optional) null

docs.title: ScoreRequest
docs.text:
Score a fitted model with replayed preprocessing.

Field Type Default Description apiVersion mapi/v1 required kind ScoreRequest required model string required endpoint://project/alias or model://project/name@vN mode predict or forecast or counterfactual or simulate or filter or evaluate predict horizon Horizon (optional) null inputs_stage string raw data string (optional) null scenario string (optional) null side_tables map of string – select map of list of string or integer or number or boolean – interventions list of Intervention – max items 256 output OutputSelector – seed integer (optional) null future_covariates FutureCovariates (optional) null M3: how forecasts get future covariates (default: supplied)

docs.title: Aggregation
docs.text:
Reduce outputs over dims before summarising (validity depends on representation).

Field Type Default Description over list of string required min items 1, max items 16 how sum or mean or min or max sum

docs.title: FutureCovariates
docs.text:
Where future values of future_required covariates come from in a forecast (M3). supplied (default) needs them in the request's data or scenario (MISSING_FUTURE_COVARIATE otherwise). The other policies let the runner extend them over the horizon, per series, inside the sandbox: carry_last repeats the last observed value, seasonal_naive repeats the value one season earlier (the time dim's yearly period), zero sets them to zero (e.g. "no spend planned").

One of supplied, carry_last, seasonal_naive, zero.

docs.title: Horizon
docs.text: Field Type Default Description dim string required periods integer required ≥ 1, ≤ 100000

docs.title: Intervention
docs.text:
Change var on the coords selected by sel: exactly one of multiply/add/set.

Field Type Default Description var string required sel map of string or integer or number or boolean or list of string or integer or number or boolean – multiply number (optional) null add number (optional) null set number (optional) null

docs.title: OutputSelector
docs.text:
What a score request returns.

Field Type Default Description kind expected or predictive expected summary list of string (optional) null Summaries to return; default depends on representation draws integer 0 ≥ 0, ≤ 10000 thin_index bundle bundle units original or model original names dataset or canonical dataset aggregate Aggregation (optional) null vars list of string – max items 256

docs.title: Built-in steps catalog
docs.text:
Generated from the mapi-steps catalog export (python -m mapi_steps.catalog): the same static JSON the control plane uses to validate specs without importing step code. For how the steps behave together, read Built-in steps.

Step Kind Learns state Invertible Looks back Summary core.calendar feature – – – Calendar features (day of week, month, ISO week, ...) core.encode_levels feature yes – – Integer codes for categorical levels core.formula feature – – – Derived variable from an arithmetic expression core.fourier feature yes – – Fourier seasonality features core.holidays feature – – – Holiday indicators per period from a side table core.lag feature – – yes Lagged copies of variables within groups core.lag_tensor feature – – yes Lag tensor (lags 0 .. l_max-1) for in-model carry-over core.missing_indicator feature – – – Indicators of missing values core.one_hot feature yes – – One-hot indicators of categorical variables core.trend feature yes – – Polynomial time trend core.count_events reshape – – – Count events per period on a dense grid core.filter_coords reshape – – – Select labels of a dim core.resample reshape – – – Aggregate a time dim to a coarser frequency core.stack reshape – – – Stack dims into one core.to_long reshape – – – Padded ragged data to long form core.to_padded reshape – – – Long ragged data to padded form with a mask core.unstack reshape – – – Unstack a dim into several core.adstock value – – yes Adstock (carry-over) with fixed parameters core.clip value – – – Clip values to bounds core.fx_convert value – yes – Currency conversion with per-period rates from a side table core.impute value yes – – Fill missing values (mean, median, constant or forward fill) core.log1p value – yes – log(1 + x) of the named variables core.logit value – yes – Logit of proportions core.max_abs_scale value yes yes – Divide by the maximum absolute value over the named dims core.mean_scale value yes yes – Divide by the mean absolute value over the named dims core.replace_sentinel value – – – Turn sentinel codes into missing values core.saturation value – – – Saturation curve with fixed parameters core.standardize value yes yes – Standardise to zero mean and unit variance over the named dims

docs.title: core.calendar
docs.text:
Adds calendar facts such as the month or whether it is a weekend

version 1.0.0 · kind feature

- {id: my_calendar, use: core.calendar@^1, with: {...}}
Field Type Default Description along string time features list of day_of_week or day_of_month or day_of_year or week_of_year or month or quarter or year or is_weekend or is_month_start or is_month_end required min items 1, max items 10 out string calendar Schema effect template 
{
  "template_params": [
    "out",
    "along"
  ],
  "transforms_dims": {
    "{out}_feature": {
      "kind": "categorical",
      "policy": "fixed"
    }
  },
  "adds": {
    "{out}": {
      "dims": [
        "{along}",
        "{out}_feature"
      ],
      "dtype": "float64"
    }
  }
}

docs.title: core.encode_levels
docs.text:
Numbers each category

version 1.0.0 · kind feature · learns state on the training data

- {id: my_encode_levels, use: core.encode_levels@^1, with: {...}}
Field Type Default Description vars list of string [] Categorical variables to encode (max items 256) dims list of string [] Dims whose labels to encode (max items 256) role covariate or index covariate max_levels integer 100000 ≥ 1, ≤ 1000000 unseen_levels error or pooled or fill error error, fill (fill_code) or pooled (one shared code n_levels) fill_code integer -1 Code for missing values and 'fill' unseen levels Schema effect template 
{
  "template_params": [
    "vars",
    "dims",
    "role"
  ],
  "derives": {
    "{*vars as v}_code": {
      "from": "{v}",
      "dtype": "int64",
      "role": "{role}",
      "missing": "forbid",
      "units": "1"
    }
  },
  "adds": {
    "{*dims as d}_code": {
      "dims": [
        "{d}"
      ],
      "dtype": "int64",
      "role": "{role}"
    }
  }
}

docs.title: core.formula
docs.text:
Creates a new column from a formula such as price * units

version 1.0.0 · kind feature

- {id: my_formula, use: core.formula@^1, with: {...}}
Field Type Default Description out string required Name of the new variable expr string required dims list of string [] Dims of the result (broadcast if it has fewer) (max items 256) role covariate or media or spend or control or constant or weight or exposure or mask covariate units string (optional) null Schema effect template 
{
  "template_params": [
    "out",
    "dims",
    "role",
    "units"
  ],
  "adds": {
    "{out}": {
      "dims": "{dims}",
      "dtype": "float64",
      "role": "{role}",
      "units": "{units}",
      "missing": "allow"
    }
  }
}

docs.title: core.fourier
docs.text:
Adds smooth repeating patterns (for example yearly seasonality)

version 1.0.0 · kind feature · learns state on the training data

- {id: my_fourier, use: core.fourier@^1, with: {...}}
Field Type Default Description along string time period number required Season length in units of unit (> 0) order integer 2 ≥ 1, ≤ 50 out string fourier unit step or days step 'step': periods of the dim's frequency; 'days': calendar days Schema effect template 
{
  "template_params": [
    "out",
    "along"
  ],
  "transforms_dims": {
    "{out}_mode": {
      "kind": "categorical",
      "policy": "fixed"
    }
  },
  "adds": {
    "{out}": {
      "dims": [
        "{along}",
        "{out}_mode"
      ],
      "dtype": "float64"
    }
  }
}

docs.title: core.holidays
docs.text:
Marks periods that contain public holidays

version 1.0.0 · kind feature · reads side tables via table

- {id: my_holidays, use: core.holidays@^1, with: {...}}
Field Type Default Description table string required Side table with a daily (or finer) holiday variable along string time table_along string (optional) null Time dim of the table, if different table_var string holiday Indicator/weight variable in the table out string holiday by list of string [] Dims shared by table and data (e.g. country/geo) (max items 256) how sum or max sum Aggregate table rows inside each data period (count or any) freq string (optional) null Frequency of along (default: from the data) missing_levels error or zero error Levels of by dims absent from the table: error or zero Schema effect template 
{
  "template_params": [
    "out",
    "along",
    "by"
  ],
  "adds": {
    "{out}": {
      "dims": [
        "{along}",
        "{*by}"
      ],
      "dtype": "float64",
      "role": "control"
    }
  }
}

docs.title: core.lag
docs.text:
Adds last period's (or earlier) values as extra columns

version 1.0.0 · kind feature · depends on the target (recursive at forecast time)

- {id: my_lag, use: core.lag@^1, with: {...}}
Field Type Default Description vars list of string required min items 1, max items 256 along string time within list of string [] Group dims (dense) or row group variables (long) (max items 256) mask string (optional) null Boolean variable; cells where it is False count as missing lags list of integer required min items 1, max items 64 lag_dim string lag fill number (optional) null Value for lags with no history (default NaN)

Context need (per group, stored at fit): {"along": "{along}", "n": "{max:lags}", "within": "{within}", "min_lag": "{min:lags}"}

Schema effect template 
{
  "template_params": [
    "vars",
    "lag_dim"
  ],
  "transforms_dims": {
    "{lag_dim}": {
      "kind": "integer",
      "policy": "fixed"
    }
  },
  "derives": {
    "{*vars as v}_lagged": {
      "from": "{v}",
      "append_dims": [
        "{lag_dim}"
      ],

docs.title: Roadmap
docs.text:
modeling-api ships as three products, in this order: a typed modelling runtime, a job platform around it, and a hosted multi-user platform. The rules that make the last one safe (no pickle, JSON-only contracts, static validation, sanitized plots, sandboxed runs whose outputs are verified) are in the code from the first release.

timeline
    title Releases
    v0.1 · M0 · contract layer : SDK, specs and schemas : 28 steps, PyMC and sklearn base classes : 11 built-in models, plots, sanitizer : conformance corpus
    v0.2 · M1 · local platform : HTTP API, queue, sandboxed runner : GCS shim, signed bundles : Expert web app, CLI, Python client : make dev and Docker Compose
    v0.3 · M2 · cloud and multi-tenant : tenants, OIDC sign-in, tokens, row-level security : quotas, fair share, cost ledger, kill switches : Cloud Run Jobs executor, Terraform : observability, security suite, chaos
    v0.4 · M3 · Guided mode and integrations (now) : templates, question flow, business priors : scorecard, what-if, forecasts : endpoints, snippets, webhooks, embeds, Atlas : sign-up, deletion, GDPR export
    v0.5 · M4 · expert plugins (next) : plugin upload for allow-listed teams : curated MCP server : in-sandbox optimize jobs : sweeps, backtests, SBC
Release Milestone Theme Status v0.1 M0 The contract layer: specs, the xarray runtime, steps, models, plots, the conformance corpus, all in your own Python process available v0.2 M1 The local platform: the same work as API calls and sandboxed runs, with the Expert web app, on a laptop or one Docker host available v0.3 M2 Cloud and multi-tenant core: tenants, sign-in, tokens, quotas and cost; one fresh sandbox per run on Cloud Run; a private beta available v0.4 M3 Guided mode and integrations: analysts from spreadsheet to report and scenario; endpoints, webhooks and embeds for other apps; the first public launch this release v0.5 M4 Expert plugins, MCP and optimisation jobs: plugin upload for allow-listed teams, a curated MCP server, in-sandbox optimize, sweeps and backtests next

docs.title: What v0.4 contains
docs.text:
• Guided mode: four templates (geo marketing mix, weekly forecast, demand by store, customer choice), a question flow with role detection, drafts with "View as YAML", the persona lock (tutorial)
  • Sandboxed ingest of CSV, Parquet, MFF and Meridian-shaped tables with plain-language refusals; the BayesInsight import and the mmm.bayesinsight model (import tutorial)
  • Business priors as ROI or share ranges, translated in a sandbox with a prior-predictive preview, and lift tests as calibration (Guided modelling)
  • The sanity scorecard written by every fit, and the promotion gate that uses it
  • What-if sliders over per-draw response grids, "Run exact", forecast and counterfactual views
  • Endpoints and aliases, score:<alias> tokens, snippets in seven languages, a Google Sheets card (Connect Google Sheets)
  • Signed webhooks with an outbox, retries, a delivery log, replays and an SSRF guard (Receive webhooks)
  • Saved plots, static renders and embed links (Embed a chart)
  • The Python client's endpoints and Atlas RemoteModel (Optimise a budget); new CLI commands
  • Sign-up with e-mail verification and abuse controls, tenant deletion, the GDPR export, and a Cloud Armor policy
  • The Integrations hub, trust pages and admin additions in the web app

Verified end to end on a laptop (M3 verification). Still to come for M3's exit: the sessions with five non-technical testers. Still to do against a real Google Cloud project, as for v0.3: the [verify M0] checklist, cold-start measurements, and public workspaces running on an executor that enforces egress and DNS.

docs.title: Next: v0.5 · M4, expert plugins, MCP and optimisation jobs
docs.text: Allow-listed teams upload their own model plugins: built into hash-pinned overlays (with native wheels from a curated mirror), checked by the contract kit on upload, with fast dev overlays and a vetted tier of ported sibling models. A curated MCP server gives agents a small, injection-safe set of tools. Atlas optimisations run as in-sandbox optimize jobs, and Sweep, Backtest and SBC run as one parent each. More.

docs.title: After v0.5
docs.text:
In the order they are planned:

  1. Public code upload (M5): uploaded plugins for every tenant, behind a separate execution project, signed base images, verification before any code runs, Sybil controls, a takedown process, a rehearsed kill-switch drill and an external penetration test, with the security suite green for two weeks first.
  2. Scale and depth (M6), each when real usage asks for it: warm scorers for sub-second exact answers, GPU and large-data executors, other clouds, recursive forecasting, chained models (full-funnel and KPI graphs), and a plugin marketplace with a consent model.

Dates

Releases are cut when their exit criteria pass, not on a calendar. Follow the changelog for what has landed.
